# Whiteheap

> Whiteheap builds open-source tools and infrastructure for agents, developers and security teams, all in Rust. Each tool is one binary with no runtime to install, and every release carries SHA-256 checksums and a GitHub build-provenance attestation.

To check that a release file is what Whiteheap built: `gh attestation verify <file> --repo whiteheap/<tool>`.

## Tools

- [residue](https://residue.whiteheap.com/): Reclaim your storage from Git worktrees, automatically and safely. residue removes a worktree only when nothing in it would be lost, whichever coding agent left it. One Rust binary with one dependency (`libc`), for macOS, Linux and FreeBSD.

## Install

- [residue's install script](https://residue.whiteheap.com/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://residue.whiteheap.com/install.sh | sh` installs residue and, on macOS and Linux, turns on automatic cleanup. Homebrew alone installs residue without it: `brew install whiteheap/tap/residue`

## Docs

- [residue's README](https://github.com/whiteheap/residue#readme): how to install it, inspect a worktree, remove one and automate cleanup, and its platforms and limits

## Source

- [whiteheap/residue](https://github.com/whiteheap/residue): residue's source and releases
- [github.com/whiteheap](https://github.com/whiteheap): every Whiteheap repository, this website's included
